say:1:1120509001:1.text: Hey, that big guy following behind you looks quite strong! He must be the one causing the commotion in town!
say:1:1120509001:1.source_cn: 呀，小丫头，你身后跟着的这大家伙，够壮实！镇上的骚动肯...

say:2:1120509002:1.text: How much did you spend to get him? He probably wasn't cheap, huh? I heard that the <style="highlight">auction</style> is full of shills driving up the prices.
say:2:1120509002:1.source_cn: 你花了多少钱才拿下它？估计不便宜吧，听说那<style...

say:4:1120509004:1.text: You don't know? Then forget what I said.
say:4:1120509004:1.source_cn: 不知道？那就别在意，当我没说。

say:5:1120509005:1.text: Come take a look at the hides! All acquired in the past couple of days, and I guarantee the quality is top-notch!
say:5:1120509005:1.source_cn: 还是来看看我家的兽皮吧！都是我这两天新收的，质量绝对没的说！

say:6:1120509006:1.text: I want the big ones! Antandra said one has to be as big as a tent! Hmmm... I need fifty of them!
say:6:1120509006:1.source_cn: 要，长毛的！安丹姐说……嗯，要帐篷那么大，五十张！

say:7:1120509007:1.text: That's quite a bulk order. Let me check if I have enough in stock at the store.
say:7:1120509007:1.source_cn: 这量可不小啊，等我算算店里这些够不够。

say:9:1120509008:1.text: Hey, guess what? I happen to have exactly fifty hides!
say:9:1120509008:1.source_cn: 哟，正正好！卖完你这五十张，我这儿就只剩几张边角料了。

say:10:1120509009:1.text: Let me just do the math... Okay, considering the bulk purchase, I'll knock off 10% and round down... Two hundred gold coins! Cash or trade-in, your choice?
say:10:1120509009:1.source_cn: 让我算一下总价……嗯，你要了这么多，打个九折再抹零……...

choice_prompt:11:1120509009.text: Let me just do the math... Okay, considering the bulk purchase, I'll knock off 10% and round down... Two hundred gold coins! Cash or trade-in, your choice?
choice_prompt:11:1120509009.source_cn: 让我算一下总价……嗯，你要了这么多，打个九折再抹零……就这个数吧，两百枚金币！现金还是拿东西抵押？

say:12:1120509010:2.text: That's outrageous! Four gold coins for just one hide...
say:12:1120509010:2.source_cn: 就是啊，一张毛皮居然要四枚金币……！

say:13:1120509013:1.text: Ah, you folks clearly don't know quality when you see it. A hide this sturdy is a steal at four gold coins.
say:13:1120509013:1.source_cn: 唉，一看你们就不识货。这么结实的兽皮，卖四金币都算便宜的。

say:14:1120509014:1.text: Plus, you're not even the ones paying! Let the smart girl here figure things out! I'm sure she knows this is a good deal!
say:14:1120509014:1.source_cn: 再说了，又不是你们付钱，小丫头还在算呢。这价格，你们不吃亏！

say:15:1120509015:1.text: Hmmm, Antandra gave me four hundred for two things... and half of four hundred is two hundred...
say:15:1120509015:1.source_cn: 唔，安丹姐给了四百，要买两样东西……四百的一半是两百……

say:16:1120509016:1.text: That's exactly half! I can totally get these hides!

choice_prompt:17:1120509016.text: That's exactly half! I can totally get these hides!

say:19:1120509020:1.text: Don't worry! Leave the bargaining to me and <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:19:1120509020:1.source_cn: 不用担心，砍价的事就包在我和<style=stress...
say:19:1120509020:1.male: Don't worry! Leave the bargaining to me and <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:19:1120509020:1.female: Don't worry! Leave the bargaining to me and <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

choice:17:0:1.text: Hold on, the price can be lower.
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 先别答应，价格还能更低
choice:17:0:1.male: Hold on, the price can be lower.
choice:17:0:1.female: Hold on, the price can be lower.

choice:17:1:2.text: You need to budget enough to buy jars!
choice:17:1:2.male: You need to budget enough to buy jars!
choice:17:1:2.female: You need to budget enough to buy jars!

say:23:1120509011:1.text: Well, here's Alkali, not everyone carries that much gold around.
say:23:1120509011:1.source_cn: 这里是咸水镇，你不能指望每个人身上都随身带着那么多钱。
say:23:1120509011:1.male: Well, here's Alkali, not everyone carries that much gold around.
say:23:1120509011:1.female: Well, here's Alkali, not everyone carries that much gold around.

say:24:1120509012:2.text: Hold on, that's not the point! Four gold coins for one hide is just too pricey!
say:24:1120509012:2.source_cn: 重点不是这个啦！一张毛皮要四枚金币，这个价格是不是……
